attributes.action: Make it illegal to use the likeness of a child/minor to promote pornography
attributes.additional_details: Make it illegal to use the likeness, image, or digitally recreated likeness of any child or minor in pornography, including AI-generated or digitally manipulated content. Children cannot consent to being depicted in sexual material, and their likeness should be legally protected from exploitation. We call on the UK Government to strengthen the law and introduce clear penalties for creating, possessing or distributing such content.
attributes.background: Make it illegal to use the likeness of any child or minor in pornography, including AI-generated, digitally altered or manipulated content. Children cannot consent to sexualised material, and their likeness should be legally protected from exploitation, regardless of how the content is created.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject which you may wish to sign:

Ban children & their likeness being used to promote pornography or adult-content
